platform_baseline.re-recorded_from: AnyWear-Infra final source synth (#158 step C extension)
platform_baseline.reason: The Workload consumer left this app, so the beta and prod Platform templates no longer contain the CDK weak cross-stack PublishOutput* outputs; the same re-record records the issue #161 recovery targets and the 34/35-value stage contract as template content instead of a permanent comparator allowance.

log_grant_rerecord.reason: The live Beta one-shot execution role keeps the awslogs CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents grant that AwsLogDriver.bind() appended while the Workload shared this app; the synthesized Platform policy now states it explicitly. These three baselines were re-recorded from the same source synth and differ from the previous templates only by that one statement; dev has no one-shot execution role and is unchanged.

platform_baseline.dev_note: dev has no PublishOutput* output and no contract or recovery change; it is re-recorded only so the declared fixture Lambda asset location is recorded in the template and every Platform comparison is exact.
platform_baseline.move_anchor: The three Workload baseline templates deleted in #158 step C, and their byte-identical `move` proof from Infra 5c571cd, are recorded in AnyWear-Service's infra/test/baselines/provenance.json at its move-anchor commit; they are not duplicated here.

three_stack_split.reason: Beta becomes three stacks with disjoint lifetimes. The Base stack (AnyWearPlatformStack-beta, name retained) keeps the persistent VPC subnets, Aurora, S3, Cognito, ECR, SQS, SSM and both CloudFront distributions, publishes api_base_url, and no longer carries NAT/EIP/private routes or the S3 gateway endpoint (moved to AnyWearEgressStack-beta). All three Platform baselines were re-recorded from this source synthesis; the stopped Beta variant and its directory were deleted with the environmentRunning switch. Foundation and Billing remain the Service move anchor.

scope: Source synth comparison only.
